articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé scores stunner, breaks France goal record in Senegal win
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé moved ahead of Lionel Messi in the World Cup career scoring charts and became France's record goal scorer with two goals in Les Bleus' 3-1 Group I win against Senegal.

articles.headline: Mbappé rewrites France, World Cup history books as Les Bleus beat Senegal
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé made history with a pair of goals that sent France on their way to a Group I-opening win over Senegal on Tuesday in New Jersey.

articles.headline: Mbappé double leads France to opening game win
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé becomes France's top all-time goal scorer, moving above Olivier Giroud in their 3-1 win over Senegal.
